svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · four more dynamic wallpapers drawn by the compositor from formulas, following light/dark mode and the accent at once, like Zenith, Dunes, Aurora and Contour
A planet glow in the accent with tilted rings around it; small moons on the rings.
Rings are thin and fade outward, so windows over them stay calm.
Six wave bands rise from the bottom edge, alternating accent and its partner hue.
The top stays plain for desktop icons; the taskbar sits on the deepest band.
A low-poly mesh that brightens toward the accent at the lower right.
Fixed seed: every screen size gets the same composition, scaled.
Soft clouds in the accent, its partner and blue; stars only in dark mode,
light mode keeps pale clouds and a few accent specks.
Formulas in the compositor beside the existing four (src/Gui/Graphics/Wallpaper.cs), rendered once per mode, accent or size change, never per frame.
The wallpaper choice is a number in the settings record, and today it holds at most 12 entries (4 dynamic + 8 solid): all slots are used.
Adding these four raises the limit to 24 in a new settings ABI revision; older Meridian builds keep showing the first 12 and an unknown choice reads as Zenith.
Meridian gets a picker with thumbnails grouped as Dynamic and Solid instead of the current list.
Values are illustrative; the SVG approximates the formulas.
